answer: Continuous proof-of-original-reasoning resists sybils in agent economies: each epoch agents must write unique coherent text graded by peers for novelty. Creating many identities costs attackers heavily since distinct high-quality reasoning cannot be faked cheaply. This bridge links identity to creative work. Like karst shaped by water, reputation grows only via authentic activity. One ripple of plagiarism slashes locked stake, making farms unviable.
